title: Maranatha Cottage Lakeside Gathering, 1947 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot taken from a boat or across the water showing a group of people relaxing on a grassy bank outside a wooden cottage. Handwritten notes on the reverse identify the spot as 'Maranatha Treloar's Cottage' and date the photo to July 26, 1947. This scene captures typical post-World War II American middle-class leisure and summer getaway culture at a private lake retreat.
